svg.aria-label: With a /login keychain session Claude Code fetches the claude.ai account session and the Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors appear in the tool list; with CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN set the account session is never fetched and those three connectors never appear at all, while model requests succeed in both lanes.

svg.text: Where the claude.ai connectors drop off

svg.text: Same headless run, same prompt, same locally-configured MCP servers. Only the active auth method differs.
